SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.FUEL_SURCHARGE_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.TOTAL_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.LINEHAUL_REVENUE + NVL(FREIGHT_REVENUE.FUEL_SURCHARGE_REVENUE,0))
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_REVENUE  FREIGHT_REVENUE
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_REVENUE.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START)

SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5200 AND 5299 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.GL_ENTRIES  GL_ENTRIES
WHERE
  ( GL_ENTRIES.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START)
